name: Bah'r Kilido
description: The Bah'r Kilido were a species pink-skinned humanoids with long faces and thin limbs. Their noses and chins were studded with a pair of short tusks. Suppoon was a member of this species.

data.name: Bah'r Kilido
data.distinctions: Large horns on their chins and where their nostrils should be
